'''Guerschon Yabusele''' (born December 17, 1995) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Rouen Métropole Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]]. He is considered one of the best international prospect for the [[2016 NBA draft]].<ref name="cbssports">{{cite web|last1=Vecenie|first1=Sam|title=NBA Draft Prospect Rankings|url=http://www.cbssports.com/nba/draft/prospect-rankings|website=[[CBS Sports]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref><ref name="draftexpress">{{cite web|title=Guerschon Yabusele|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Guerschon-Yabusele-66311/|website=DraftExpress|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Guerschon Yabusele|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/guerschon-yabusele|website=NBADraft.net|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=A list of international players who might tempt the Sixers|url=http://www.philly.com/philly/blogs/pattisonave/A-list-of-international-players-who-might-tempt-the-Sixers.html|website=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Yabusele was born and raised in [[Dreux|Dreux, France]]. Throughout the early portions of his life, Yabusele had his upbringings as a [[boxer]].<ref>http://www.brightsideofthesun.com/2016/6/3/11852930/phoenix-suns-pre-draft-workouts-day-8-a-diamond-in-the-rough</ref> He began playing basketball with the youth sections of [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] in 2012, competing with their under-21 team.<ref name=eurobasket />

== Professional career ==
Yabusele joined the official Roanne team of the [[LNB Pro B]] in 2013 and finished the season averaging 1.5 points per game in 8 appearances. He remained with the team for the next season, after which he averaged six points, four rebounds, and 1.7 assists.<ref name="eurobasket">{{cite web|title=Guerschon Yabusele|url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Guerschon_Yabusele/France/SPO_Rouen_Basket/263342|website=[[Eurobasket.com]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref> Yabusele signed with [[Rouen Métropole Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]], the top league in France, in the summer of 2015. He made the decision to help his NBA draft stock.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Lacoste|first1=Alexandre|title=Guerschon Yabusele Trois Ans À Rouen|url=http://www.bebasket.fr/a/51887-guerschon-yabusele-trois-ans-a-rouen|website=BeBasket.fr|accessdate=9 March 2016|language=French}}</ref> Yabusele would wind up being one of 13 international underclassmen (and one of four different Frenchmen) to officially enter their names for the [[2016 NBA Draft]]. He is currently projected to be either a late first round or early second round selection.
